claim: On synthetic three-mechanism transitions, TRACE reports mixing-weight correlation 0.94 +/- 0.05 and up to 0.99 after calibration, above NCTRL-hard 0.67 and NCTRL-soft 0.72.

trace_side_endpoints_preregistered_befor.best_mixing_correlation: at least 0.97, as scoped support for 'up to 0.99'

full_claim_verdict_rule: TRACE-side success alone cannot verify the comparative claim. VERIFIED additionally requires a faithful NCTRL-hard and NCTRL-soft run at the stated scale, with raw outputs and independent checks. A mismatch is not FALSIFIED unless implementation and data parity are established.
negative_control: Deterministically permute predicted time indices. Mean correlation must fall below 0.50 and the checker exits 1.
exact_comparator_claim: NCTRL-hard reports 0.67 +/- 0.03 and NCTRL-soft reports 0.72 +/- 0.01 on TRACE continuous synthetic trajectories.
comparator_verification_rule: Requires exact adaptation, training protocol, checkpoints or reproducible training, hard and soft inference definitions, aligned data, raw outputs, and independent recomputation.
falsification_rule: Requires an exact-protocol contradictory result; missing code or an invented adaptation is not falsification.
